I purchased this packing cube to take my daughters items to the hospital for her birth and it arrived right before I went into labor. 

The quality is great, however, the image in the listing appears to have a filter which caused a misrepresentation of the true color. I found the thread color hard to read and the embroidery was not centered. I reached out to the shop and they quickly responded with a resolution to send me a new item. I chose the lighter thread color and the replacement arrived quickly. The font was not the same as the original I picked but still very pretty. Hot pink embroidery was the first and light pink is second. 
I’m very excited for my daughter to use this for years to come.
